reason: The reviewer's finding matches the ground truth exactly: both identify that first() is imported but never invoked on the Flow<ProgramState?> returned by programStateRepo.observe(program.id), so initialState is bound to the Flow object itself (never null) rather than its first emitted value. Both conclude that initialState == null is therefore always false, forcing startDestination to always resolve to Main and making onboarding unreachable for new users with no ProgramState. Same location, same mechanism, same runtime consequence.
